title: The learned policy meets the robot — and misses its budget 2.6x
question: Does the PPO policy transfer to hardware, and does it fit the 5 ms control budget?
headline: It balanced the full 10 s at 2.43 deg RMS — while running at 69 Hz, not 200, because the forward pass costs 13.1 ms against a 5 ms budget. A policy trained at 200 Hz surviving on a third of that, with ~14 ms of extra actuation delay, is a better robustness result than the RMS suggests.
hub_output: forward pass: 13065 us of a 5000 us budget
WARNING: over half the control period goes to the policy
